page.overview:
Who is Gibeon?

Gibeon was the head and founder of the Explorers, and the primary antagonist appearing in .

Gibeon is an elderly man with long, silver hair that has a light pink ombré color, and dark pink eyes.

As seen when Gibeon used a fragment of Laquium on one of his sleeves, when it is inserted, the sleeve's lines turn from purple and green to pink. There is also a black cannula that almost looks like a noodle from the upper back of his shirt, running through his hair, which means he invented his clothes to make himself an eternity.

In his youth, Gibeon's hair was bluer in hues and lacked the pink shades.
